verdict.description: request_changes if and only if at least one blocking item remains.

body.description: Review summary in Markdown: every blocking item as a numbered list, then the non-blocking notes.

comments.description: Findings tied to a line in the diff.

line.description: Line number in the new version of the file; must be inside the diff.

polish.description: Only when approving: small mechanical changes that need no judgement and cannot change behaviour. The loop applies them once, then reviews again. Empty when requesting changes.

line.description: Line number in the new version of the file.

body.description: The exact change, concrete enough to apply without guessing.

for_human.description: Findings the fixer must not settle: code and a spec that disagree where either could be right, or a mechanical change in a file the fixer may not edit. They do not block; an approval with any of them goes to a human with needs-human.

line.description: Line number in the new version of the file; must be inside the diff.

body.description: What a human has to decide or do. For a one-line replacement, end with a GitHub suggestion block.
